Full summary: Tasks 12+13 (inline): graph drill-down explorer shipped (js/graph-view.js) — overview meta-graph (6 type nodes at 5k), searchable paged entity lists, ego explorer capped at 150 with per-type overflow chip paging, re-anchor breadcrumb, 200-node eviction cap; graph table repointed to paged /api/graph/entities. Legacy render-everything path deleted (~700 lines: buildGraphStyles, initGraphVis, buildGraphElements, expandNeighbors, updateGraphData, renderGraph). Browser-verified at 5k, 0 console errors. PHASE 4 COMPLETE.
Decisions: Committed Tasks 12 and 13 as one commit rather than the plan's two — overview/entity-list/ego live in one module and the legacy deletion cross-cuts both; splitting would have manufactured an artificial intermediate state. Deviation from plan recorded rather than silently merged.; Graph table detail panel shows name/type/degree + 'Explore in graph' button instead of the old properties JSON — the paged endpoint doesn't carry properties; full property detail remains reachable via legacy navigateToId and can move to a single-entity endpoint later if missed.; Overview meta-graph drops self-loop type edges (file→file etc.) — they dominate visually on a circle layout while carrying little orientation value; counts still appear in group_edges data.
Findings: Bulk python deletion of app.js blocks broke a brace (handleSort's blackboard if-block closer was on the same line as the removed else-if) — caught by node --check before any browser run. Lesson: always node --check after scripted multi-block deletions of legacy JS.; Fixture quirk: entity names don't match their type field (name concept-7 can be type class) because the seeder picks name-prefix and type independently — cosmetic only, but worth fixing in the seeder if it confuses future visual verification.
